findings.title: Approved test claim was not produced
findings.specimen: Approval/spec commit 79cb6842448232e057cb98adbd9e989a9817350d claims tests/test_ledger.py, but build commit 71437296d8f03667106e913d67e4a4f601d47c91 changes only bin/attavo among the claimed product files
findings.retires: Closes the assumption that passing acceptance scripts proves the approved working-tree change, including its regression-test claim, was delivered
findings.rejection_test: test_build_diff_covers_every_approved_claim — compare the approved spec's Claims paths with the build diff and require tests/test_ledger.py to be changed; additionally, test_ledger_batched_walk_preserves_rows_and_summary would directly compare ledger classifications and summaries across merged, unmerged, pre-v0.18, and missing/malformed-record histories
findings.severity: Blocking when an approved Claims entry is absent from the build diff; harmless only if the approval is amended to remove tests/test_ledger.py before accepting the build
